description: Ways to get items that are not crafting or furnace recipes (breaking blocks, using a tool on a block, the start kit), for howToGet. Hand-written from docs/research/rotn-progression.md, which cites the RotN wiki ([W-...]), the in-game handbook ([HB ...]) and the pinned pack's scripts and configs ([R:...]). Every rule names its evidence. confidence: 'documented' = a cited source states it; 'inferred' = derived from dumped names or a documented rule applied to variants the source does not name. 'unverified' lists the parts no harness run has checked yet. In rules with 'pairs' or 'stoneFamilies' the confidence is per pair: a pair is 'documented' only if it says "documented": true (or is in documentedMetas), otherwise 'inferred'. The dump's own block drops (getItemDropped with a fixed seed) miss event-handler drops such as Pyrotech's stone-to-rocks, so these rules come first.

sources.summary: Break a rock pile on the ground by hand; it drops the rock of its own type (the item meta equals the block meta). Near the G3 spawn most piles are Underground Biomes rock piles (pyrotech_compat:rock_metamorphic, _igneous, _sedimentary).
evidence: docs/research/rotn-progression.md section 1 step 1: [W-Getting_Started] 'rocks from rock piles on the ground'
G2 batch 5 (coord/STATUS-harness-ops.md): pyrotech:rock piles with metas 6 and 8 near spawn, so rock piles generate in the Overworld
the dump: pyrotech:rock block states 0-10 and item variants 0-10 have the same names (Stone Rock, ..., Red Sandstone Rock)

the dump (blocks.json): pyrotech_compat:rock_igneous (metas 0-7), rock_metamorphic (0-7) and rock_sedimentary (0-5), classes trinsdar.pyrotech_compat.block.rocks.BlockRock*: every state has no collision box, hardness 0.1 and no harvest tool, and drops the item of the same name and the same meta (getItemDropped/damageDropped); each state's variant matches the item variant's display name (rock_red_granite / Red Granite Rock, rock_soapstone / Soapstone Rock, rock_chalk / Chalk Rock, ...). These items are in the 'rock' ore dictionary (wildcard meta), so they make the crude axe, Crafting Tools and stone tools

S1-A survey (coord/STATUS-harness-ops.md; test/evidence/s1/s1a-20261102/survey/result.json), G2 world, radius 48 around the fresh spawn: pyrotech_compat:rock_metamorphic meta 0 (81 blocks) and 6 (23), rock_igneous 0 (71) and 7 (8), rock_sedimentary 0 (15), 1 (1) and 2 (1); pyrotech:rock only meta 4 (3, a Dirt Clump)

which piles give a rock that rock recipes accept: the dump's oredict.json 'rock' (packages/rotn-data/3.3.4/oredict.json): pyrotech:rock metas 0, 6 and 8 only; pyrotech_compat:rock_igneous, rock_metamorphic and rock_sedimentary every meta (wildcard 32767). The crude axe, Crafting Tools and the stone pickaxe and axe take ore 'rock' (or flint). howToGet lists, per rule block, the metas whose drop is in the ore ('ore' on the way)
sources.inferred: The Underground Biomes rock piles (no documented flag): the research names rock piles in general and pyrotech:rock; the Underground Biomes piles and their drops come from the dump only.
unverified: that breaking a pile by hand gives exactly one item of the same meta in game (the dump's drop is getItemDropped, without event handlers)
sources.note: Metas 4 (Dirt Clump), 5 (Sand Pile), 7 (Pile of Wood Chips) and 9 (Red Sand Pile) of pyrotech:rock are not rocks: they are not in the 'rock' ore dictionary, so they do not work in rock recipes. pyrotech:rock_grass (149 blocks in S1-A) drops a Grass Clump, also not a rock.

sources.summary: Mine stone with a pickaxe below Sturdy (a stone or crude pickaxe, mining level 0); it drops 4 rocks of the stone's type instead of cobblestone.
sources.pairing: A stone state pairs with the rock variant whose display name is the state's 'variant' or 'type' property followed by ' Rock' (red_granite -> 'Red Granite Rock'), compared without case, spaces or underscores (blueschist -> 'Blue Schist Rock'), within the family's rock items. States without such a rock (smooth stone, lignite) have no pair.
evidence: docs/research/rotn-progression.md section 1 step 15 and section C: [W-Getting_Started], [W-Stone] 'any pickaxe below Sturdy drops rocks; Sturdy or better drops cobblestone'
coord/STATUS-harness-ops.md (G3 plan): spawn stone in every G2 census is Underground Biomes stone
sources.inferred: Every pair except minecraft:stone meta 0: the sources name only stone; the pairs for granite, diorite, andesite and the Underground Biomes stones come from the dumped display names.
unverified: the Underground Biomes and vanilla variant pairs
the count of 4 for variants other than stone
whether breaking stone by hand drops anything
sources.note: Pyrotech's flint pickaxe (pyrotech:flint_pickaxe) is level 1, Sturdy (docs/research/rotn-progression.md section C, module.Tool.cfg; the dump: toolClasses pickaxe 1), so by this rule it gives cobblestone, not rocks. A stone pickaxe crafted from flint (minecraft:stone_pickaxe) is level 0.

sources.summary: Mine stone with a Sturdy (level 1) or better pickaxe, such as iron; it drops cobblestone.
evidence: docs/research/rotn-progression.md section C: [W-Stone], [W-Getting_Started]
unverified: the Underground Biomes stones' cobblestone with a Sturdy pickaxe

sources.summary: Break a Dynamic Trees branch, by hand or with an axe (an axe is much faster on a thick trunk): the part of the tree above it falls in the break direction and drops its logs plus 0-7 sticks (the part of a log left over). This is the first source of sticks: leaves never drop them. Break the thinnest trunk you can reach (by hand about 1.5 s per hardness point: radius 4 about 6 s, radius 8 about 24 s) and stand to the side.
evidence: docs/research/rotn-progression.md section 1 step 4: [W-Getting_Started], [W-Tips] (trees fall in the chop direction; Dynamic Trees fork)

the dump: Dynamic Trees branch blocks dynamictrees:<wood>branch, material wood, toolRequired false (harvestTool axe, level 0); hardness = the log's hardness x radius^2 / 8 (oakbranch radius 1: 0.25, radius 2: 1), capped by config/dynamictrees.cfg line 114 maxTreeHardness=200 (BlockBranchBasic.func_176195_g)

mods/DramaticTrees-1.12.2-0.13.4.jar (SHA-256 b86dae768ccc1182c52e5b9a8756a5906da53dc125d48bfe1c8dc69204a77ffe; it holds the com.ferreusveritas.dynamictrees classes the dumped branches use): no tool check. BlockBranch.removedByPlayer -> removedByEntity -> FutureBreak -> futureBreak (bytecode 0-262): destroyBranchFromNode, getLogDrops(wood volume x (1 + 0.25 x Fortune level)), ForgeEventFactory.fireBlockHarvesting, EntityFallingTree.dropTree(HARVEST); the held item only adds Fortune and takes damageAxe

Logs and sticks: NodeNetVolume.run adds radius^2 x 64 voxels per branch block and getVolume divides by 4096; getLogDrops multiplies by config/dynamictrees.cfg line 108 harvestMultiplier=1.5; Species.getLogsAndSticks (bytecode 0-23): logs = floor(V), sticks = floor((V - logs) x 8), kept because line 96 dropSticks=true (Species$LogsAndSticks); DropCreatorLogs.getLogsDrop (bytecode 55-83) adds TreeFamily.getStick(n) = minecraft:stick (TreeFamily init bytecode 85-96, Items.field_151055_y)
No pack rule removes them: config/betterwithmods.cfg line 474 HCLumber=false, config/primallib.cfg line 37 No Tree Punching integration false, no scripts/dropt*.zs rule matches a branch

Leaves give no sticks (why this rule replaces 'sticks-from-leaves'): BlockDynamicLeaves.getDrops (bytecode 0-32) only calls Species.getLeavesDrops, whose drop creators are the seed (DropCreatorSeed.getLeavesDrop: 1 in 20, Fortune down to 1 in 10) and, on apple oaks, the apple; nothing calls TreeRegistry.registerDropCreator in DramaticTrees or the 6 Dynamic Trees addon jars; no scripts/dropt*.zs rule gives leaves a stick (only biomesoplenty:leaves_6:8/9, dropt_loose_materials.zs lines 701, 711)
G3 smoke round 4 batch B (harness-ops captures/raw/r4-g3b/night/driver.log lines 162-164, 197-199, 214): every logged dynamictrees:leaves0 break gave no stick, yet the bot, with no axe, gained sticks
sources.inferred: Every branch-to-log pair (by wood name): the research says the exact log item a tree drops is UNVERIFIED.
unverified: which log item each tree drops, and how many
logs from a tree felled by hand: the bytecode drops them as for an axe, but no harness run has shown it (round 4 B shows sticks only)
branches of other mods' trees (Biomes O' Plenty, Pam's, Quark, Twilight Forest): the same code, not listed here
